name: rusturbo
description: RustTurbo — extreme Rust compilation accelerator. Install the native binary from GitHub Releases.

scripts.preinstall:
node -e "try{const v=process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.match(/npm/(\d+)/);if(v&&+v[1]>=12)console.warn('
rusturbo: npm 12+ blocks install scripts by default.
  If the binary was not downloaded, re-run with:
    npm install -g --allow-scripts=rusturbo
')}catch{}"
